assistworld-assist-world:lever:54919b36-.title: Personal Assistant / Virtual Assistant to His Excellency
assistworld-assist-world:lever:54919b36-.description: About the Role This role supports His Excellency, a senior government official who serves as Secretary General of the Supreme Council of Youth and Sports, chairman of approximately five companies, and a board member of two others. His schedule is extremely demanding, running Sunday to Thursday with regular extra hours over the weekend. The client currently has an in-house Executive Assistant handling email correspondence; this position is a separate, dedicated Personal Assistant (with some Executive Assistant crossover) focused primarily on scheduling, travel, and day-to-day personal/logistical requests. This is a newly created position — the client has not used a virtual assistant before and is looking to bring this function on for the first time. Key Responsibilities • Manage and adjust a fast-changing weekly schedule, including short-notice changes (e.g., arranging an urgent call within the hour). • Coordinate meetings and calls via Google Meet and other Google Workspace tools. • Research and present travel options on short notice — flights, hotels, and rental options — often with multiple choices for His Excellency to select from. • Make bookings and reservations (restaurants, accommodation, travel) sometimes on evenings or weekends. • Handle ad hoc purchasing requests (e.g., sourcing and buying specific items on request). • Field and prioritize multiple simultaneous requests (up to 5 in a minute), keeping track of each accurately. • Be available for urgent, time-sensitive requests outside standard hours, including evening calls (around 8 PM) and weekend requests. • Communicate primarily via WhatsApp (or similar messaging apps). Working Hours & Time Zone • Bahrain time zone (AST, GMT+3). • Core work week: Sunday to Thursday (weekends are Friday–Saturday). • Flexibility required for urgent evening and weekend requests, given the nature of the role. Required Skills & Attributes • Fast — able to respond and act quickly under tight deadlines. • Accurate — high attention to detail, even when working at speed. • Highly organized — able to juggle multiple simultaneous requests without losing track. • Able to work under high-intensity pressure. • Confident and direct communicator — comfortable pushing back, flagging issues, or saying “I don’t have enough time for that” rather than staying quiet under pressure. His Excellency is direct and values someone who isn’t intimidated by a strong personality. • Strong research skills, particularly for travel options. • Comfortable with Google Workspace (Calendar, Meet, Gmail, Docs). • Fluent English required; additional languages are a plus, not require Why Join Assist World? 100% REMOTE $50 birthday bonus $200 testimonial bonus NO TRACKER. NO PROBLEM

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:5f9.title: Pricing & Reporting Analyst
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:5f9.description: Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection. Reports to: Sr. Pricing Analyst Location: Cottonwood Heights, Utah (Hybrid - 3x/week in-office)
responsibilities: Pull pricing, margin, and sales data from the data warehouse for ad hoc analysis
Use AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) daily to write formulas, draft SQL, automate repetitive tasks, summarize results, and accelerate your own learning
Execute daily, weekly, and seasonal price changes across four banners, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery
Monitor competitive pricing across key categories and partner brands; surface risks and opportunities to the Sr. Pricing Analyst and Buying teams
Track MAP and MSRP compliance across the assortment, flagging and correcting violations in a timely manner
Bring analytical judgment to pricing and strategy conversations—surface trends, audit outcomes, flag risks, and recommend pricing actions that improve sell-through, margin, or working capital
Build and maintain pricing reports and dashboards that Planning, Buying, and Marketing teams rely on
Document and improve pricing processes—turn one-off analyses into repeatable AI-powered workflows
Partner with Marketing on promotional pricing setup and post-promo recaps
Maintain a strong feedback loop with the Sr. Pricing Analyst on what is working, what is not, and where to push next
qualifications: 3–5 years of analyst experience, preferably in retail, ecommerce, or a related data-driven role

Demonstrated daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, or similar) for real work—you iterate on prompts, evaluate outputs critically, and know when AI is the right tool versus when it is not
High proficiency with Microsoft Excel (pivots, lookups, formulas) and a strong aptitude to learn technical applications quickly
Solid understanding of retail math (margin, markdown, sell-through, IMU) and financial concepts (GMROI, NPV, CM%)
Awareness of customer pricing behavior—anchoring, discount perception, and how merchandising and pricing decisions land on a product detail page
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with messy datasets
Excellent attention to detail—pricing errors are expensive, and you treat that responsibility seriously
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate analysis into a clear, concise recommendation
Able to work both independently and collaboratively across Planning, Buying, Marketing, and Finance
Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, or a related field preferred; equivalent demonstrated experience considered
Passion for the outdoor industry and knowledge of outdoor gear is a plus.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:6f383694-ae8a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. UX Content Designer based in United States. This is a senior content design role focused on shaping clear, trustworthy, and engaging digital experiences within a growing healthcare marketplace. You will influence how customers discover, understand, compare, purchase, and manage healthcare and financial products and services. The role combines UX writing, content strategy, behavioral science, and digital commerce principles to improve both customer confidence and measurable business outcomes. You will work across the full customer journey, partnering closely with design, product, research, marketing, legal, and business teams. Leverage AI-assisted writing and research tools to accelerate content creation, experimentation, and analysis while maintaining accuracy, quality, consistency, and the appropriate brand voice. jobgether-jobgether:lever:8795355d-cef9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager IV based in United States. This role offers the opportunity to lead the strategy, growth, and lifecycle management of a complex product portfolio within a highly technical environment. You will shape product roadmaps, influence new product development, and align offerings with evolving customer and market needs. Working across engineering, sales, marketing, operations, and customer-facing teams, you will drive initiatives that directly impact revenue, margins, quality, and delivery performance. The position combines strategic product leadership with hands-on ownership of pricing, forecasting, launches, market intelligence, and lifecycle decisions. You will operate with significant autonomy and influence senior stakeholders across multiple functions and levels of the organization. The role is ideal for an experienced product leader who enjoys solving complex business challenges and turning market insights into measurable results. Own the strategy and lifecycle management of assigned product lines, including product research, market analysis, competitive intelligence, positioning, roadmap development, requirements, launches, and lifecycle optimization. Develop and champion business cases, product plans, specifications, launch strategies, and ongoing portfolio initiatives aligned with customer and business priorities. Manage pricing activities, including pricing analysis for new product launches, periodic price changes, and special pricing requests. Partner closely with engineering leadership to ensure product roadmaps reflect market requirements and that new products are delivered on time and according to customer expectations. Coordinate cross-functional inputs to achieve portfolio targets across revenue, margin, quality, delivery, reliability, and overall business performance. Own demand planning and sales forecasting, using market and business insights to support accurate portfolio planning. Monitor product quality, design effectiveness, cost, reliability, and enhancement opportunities, contributing to continuous product improvement. Analyze excess and obsolete inventory and use product specifications and attributes to inform marketing strategies and commercial materials. Develop and maintain product information for marketing collateral, catalogs, customer communications, and sales enablement. Support customer and account management activities by providing product expertise, specifications, and solutions to customers and sales teams. Champion new product development initiatives and ensure the portfolio continues to address evolving customer and market needs. Coordinate product and applications training for customers, sales, customer service, applications engineering, and other relevant stakeholders. Represent the business in relevant professional associations and technical industry discussions, helping maintain awareness of market developments and emerging requirements. Lead through influence in a highly autonomous environment, building alignment across functions and levels of the organization without relying solely on direct authority. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field from an accredited college or university, or equivalent professional experience. 5–7 years of relevant product management, product development, business management, or related experience; 8+ years is preferred. Strong experience managing product portfolios and driving initiatives across the full product lifecycle. Demonstrated ability to develop product strategies, business cases, roadmaps, forecasts, pricing plans, and launch programs. Strong analytical and commercial skills, with the ability to connect market insights and product decisions to revenue, profitability, quality, and customer outcomes.
